purpose: Convert six research proposals into accountable evidence slots for a real G2 pilot without inventing operators, venues, quotations, baselines or professional sign-off.
global_rule: No project may enter G2 until every required evidence slot contains a named accountable party, a dated attachment and a human approval record. An empty slot is unknown, never zero or approval.

resource_band_rule.S: reuse of an authorized existing space, staff time and low-technology or paper materials
resource_band_rule.M: multi-professional work, temporary equipment or one controlled instance
resource_band_rule.L: cross-site sustained operation, permanent equipment or engineering investment
resource_band_rule.limitation: Resource bands are not currency estimates. A cost baseline requires quantities, lifecycle scope and at least one auditable market or procurement basis.

g1_to_g2_required_bundle: versioned official site or room identifier and carrier authorization
named operator and accountable executive role
affected-group co-definition record and unresolved-dissent log
scope, quantity and lifecycle cost basis with quotation or procurement evidence
disaggregated baseline plan with data owner and observation window
data purpose, minimum-data boundary and deletion record
human-takeover drill, ordinary-service fallback and accessibility check
complaint, incident, stop, clearing, restoration and re-entry protocol

projects.required_carrier: authorized railway-heritage park, road or public-space interface
authorized controlled test room or bounded outdoor test carrier

projects.project_name: AI Origin open-source and transfer front desk
projects.required_carrier: authorized publicly accessible room or staffed service counter
verified station-area and street-walk audit boundary, not an inferred engineering route
baseline_required: waiting and detour by user group

projects.required_carrier: authorized public-service carrier with verified power, network, fire, accessibility and ordinary-service capacity
baseline_required: waiting and transfer time by group

projects.required_carrier: authorized event venues and a verified public-space itinerary with weather fallback

release_limit: This register proves readiness of the handoff schema only. It does not prove a venue, operator, budget, baseline, approval, signature or implementation commitment exists.
